name: Foam Roller Hamstring Roll
steps: Sit with the roller beneath one thigh, both hands behind you and your other foot planted on the floor.
Lift your hips off the floor and roll smoothly from just below your glute down to just above the back of your knee.
Turn your leg slightly inward and outward to cover the full width of the hamstring, pausing briefly on tight areas.
Continue rolling steadily for the duration on one leg, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your shoulders pressed down away from your ears while supporting your weight on your hands.
Avoid rolling directly behind your knee joint.
